steps.name: $("open") http://nginx:80/table/delayed-table.html

$("#customers/By.xpath: (.//tr)[position() > 1].findBy(row with 'Ernst Handel' in 'COMPANY' column)") should be([exist, 5s])

$("table row candidate/By.xpath: ./td[1]") has(exact text case sensitive "Ernst Handel")
